neighbours.label: round-the-clock: the '/' of '24/7', ' day' in '24 hours a day', ' clock' in 'around the clock'
fire: Our emergency vets are available 24/7, including public holidays.
The border post is manned 24 hours a day by customs officers.
Engineers worked around the clock to restore power to the town.
The gym gives members 24/7 access with a key card.
The furnace has to burn 24 hours a day or the glass will crack.
Volunteers kept watch around the clock until the river fell.
A 24/7 hotline was set up for families of the passengers.
The reception desk is staffed 24 hours a day throughout the summer.
quiet: Our emergency vets are available on weekdays, excluding public holidays.
The border post is manned from dawn to dusk by customs officers.
Engineers worked through the weekend to restore power to the town.
The gym gives members a 10/20 discount code with a key card.
The furnace has to burn six hours a day or the glass will crack.
Volunteers kept watch near the clock tower until the river fell.
A free hotline was set up for families of the passengers.
The reception desk is staffed three days a week throughout the summer.
